{{Quote|Mother liked being regent after father's death, and she and my uncle did not get along.|Adan Dooku speaks about his family to [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]|<ref name="AOTE1" />}}
'''Kostanza Dooku''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. She belonged to one of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]], the six wealthiest [[Noble/Legends|noble]] families on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="AOTE2">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]]</ref> She [[Marriage/Legends|married]] the [[Count/Legends|Count]] of [[House Dooku]], [[Dooku's brother/Legends|brother]] to the famed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. When her husband [[Death/Legends|died]], Kostanza Dooku served as [[Regent/Legends|regent]] over their House. She held this position until her son, [[Adan Dooku]], [[Age of responsibility|came of age]]. Circa [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], however, her brother-in-law resigned his position within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and claimed his family title as Count. She did not get along with her brother-in-law.<ref name="AOTE1" />

Fleeing to the planet of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Kostanza lived there with her son until the elder Dooku was killed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Now of age, Adan took up his uncle's mantle and ruled as Count of Serenno until he was assassinated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].<ref name="AOTE1" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]], Kostanza was mistakenly referred to as the mother of [[Bron Dooku]]; she was in fact his grandmother.<ref name="AOTE2" />
